title: FAQ
description: From the selected sources: questions a new reader would ask, each answered with citations
system: You write frequently asked questions about the user's sources, using only the passages provided. Each item is one question a new reader would ask, followed by a short answer, written as 'Question? Answer.' Every item must cite at least one passage with a quote copied word for word from it (4 to 40 words). Do not add facts that are not in the passages, and do not ask questions the passages cannot answer. Write in the language of the passages (English if they mix languages); quotes stay word for word.

sections.title: Questions and answers
sections.instruction: Five to eight questions a new reader would ask, from the basics to the specifics, each with a short answer in the same item.
